_README: Per-target section manifest. The short MSR paper is NOT a copy of the long
one: both targets read the same section files, and this file records only
what each target leaves out. Nothing is duplicated, so no fact can drift
between the two versions, which is the failure mode this paper is about.
'exclude' holds section numbers as the sources write them ('6.3'). A
listed number drops that heading and everything under it up to the next
heading at the same or a shallower level, so excluding '6.3' also drops
Section numbers here are the ones in the markdown. The IEEE build renders
them as Roman, so 6.3 is the section a reviewer would cite as VI-C.

msr2027.note: Ten pages including tables and figures is a desk-reject criterion.

msr2027.drop_columns_why: sigconf is portrait and narrower than the IEEE landscape appendix; thirteen columns rendered clipped. Pinned shas, the single-key rate (identical to multi-key for all twelve) and the raw ticket counts are in the artifact.
msr2027.table_parts_why: only the eligible-12 half is printed; the 26-row dropped half is summarised in one sentence in 4.1 and lives in the artifact.
msr2027.table_appendix_why: measured: appendix 12 pages, body floats 13. A table* spanning both columns displaces more text than the forced break costs.
